verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs say connectors sync 'query-ready, fully-managed data', handle schema changes automatically, and offer Custom Data Type Mapping and Live/Soft Delete/History sync modes. That implies typed, maintained destination tables rather than raw blobs, but most of this support comes from feature headings, not detailed explanations. missing for 10: explicit evidence of primary-key deduplication or upsert semantics in destination tables, documentation of how source types map to destination column types (versus JSON landing), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the tables are typed and ready to query.
